caption: Figure 1: Comparison of the proposed YOLOv4 and other state-of-the-art object detectors. YOLOv4 runs twice faster than EfficientDet with comparable performance. Improves YOLOv3's AP and FPS by 10% and 12%, respectively.
description:
Description: This figure is a line graph comparing the performance of various object detection models on the MS COCO dataset. The x-axis represents the frames per second (FPS), and the y-axis represents the average precision (AP). The highest AP is achieved by EfficientDet (D0-D4) at around 49, while the lowest is YOLOv3 at around 31. YOLOv4 (ours) is highlighted with a green line and a star marker, showing an AP of around 44 at 100 FPS.

Text in figure: MS COCO Object Detection, real-time, EfficientDet (D0-D4), YOLOv4 (ours), ASFF*, YOLOv4 (ours), YOLOv3 [63], EfficientDet [77], ATSS [94], ASFF* [48], CenterMask* [40], FPS (V100), AP.

caption: Figure 6: Modified PAN.
description:
## Section 1: Figure Description
This figure is a diagram comparing two architectures: the original PAN (Path Aggregation Network) and a modified PAN. The original PAN uses an addition operation to combine feature maps, while the modified PAN uses a concatenation operation. Both diagrams show a sequence of layers, with the final output being a combination of the previous layers.

## Section 2: Figure Details
Text in figure: "PAN [49]", "Our modified PAN", "addition", "concatenation". The original PAN diagram shows two layers being added together. The modified PAN diagram shows two layers being concatenated. Both diagrams result in a single output layer.

caption: Figure 8: Comparison of the speed and accuracy of different object detectors. (Some articles stated the FPS of their detectors for only one of the GPUs: Maxwell/Pascal/Volta)
description:
Description: The figure contains six panels, each showing a comparison of object detection models based on speed (FPS) and accuracy (AP). Each panel plots FPS against AP, with different models represented by lines and markers. The highest FPS is achieved by YOLOv4 (ours) in the first panel, while the lowest FPS is achieved by EfficientDet in the fifth panel. The highest AP is achieved by YOLOv4 (ours) in the first panel, and the lowest AP is achieved by ATSS in the fifth panel.
